t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The advice states that smaller gnomes produce more mushrooms and it's keep fingers over the keys to be ready to press them.

vb_textbox.text: Try to keep your focus as it's easy to let it slip and miss out on claiming the mushrooms by hitting the space bar. I found that selecting the smaller gnomes after the 5x multiplier appears, gets your more mushrooms, than if you pick the larger gnome with the 5x multiplier. I also felt that colour coding may play some role regarding the amount of mushrooms one gets, but could not really work it out. It's something to look out for, as you might spot a pattern. But generally speaking smaller gnomes should lead to more mushrooms with the 5x. Make sure to keep your fingers over all the keys and act quickly.
